name: Blink Outdoor 4 (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n. Per the FAQ the camera reaches your Wi-Fi through a Sync Module.

matter.note: The Outdoor 4 pages do not mention Matter, and no CSA listing was checked.

apple_home.note: The Outdoor 4 FAQ and tech specs do not mention Apple Home.

google_home.note: The Outdoor 4 FAQ and tech specs do not mention Google Home or Assistant.

alexa.note: Through the Blink SmartHome Alexa skill; the Outdoor 4 FAQ points to it. Blink's Alexa page lists live view on Echo and Fire TV, motion announcements and routines for Blink cameras in general, not this model by name.

smartthings.note: No official Blink or SmartThings page found.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant has a Blink integration, but its docs were not checked for this model.

hubRequired.note: Blink says the Outdoor 4 needs a Sync Module to connect to your Wi-Fi. It works with any Blink Sync Module and is sold separately or in bundles.

localControl.note: Blink does not state what works without its cloud.

cameraType.note: IP65 weather resistant. Removing the port cover voids that rating unless it is powered over USB-C with a weather-resistant adapter.

power.note: Two AA 1.5 V non-rechargeable lithium batteries included, rated up to 2 years at default settings. Optional weather-resistant power adapter or Battery Extension Pack (US and Canada), both sold separately.

localStorage.note: Only with a Sync Module 2 (USB drive) or Sync Module XR (microSD, US and Canada). Blink says the Sync Module Core does not support local storage.

subscription.value: Person detection and photo capture (Blink plan)
subscription.note: Includes a 30-day Blink Plus trial, then a Basic or Plus plan. Cloud storage also needs a plan or trial.

summary: Blink Outdoor 4 is Alexa-only as far as Blink says: its FAQ points to the Blink SmartHome skill, and nothing mentions Apple Home or Google Home. The camera is IP65 and runs on two AA lithium batteries. It reaches Wi-Fi through a Sync Module, and local clip storage works only with a Sync Module 2 or XR.
caveats: Needs a Sync Module, sold separately or in bundles.
Local storage needs a Sync Module 2 or XR; the Sync Module Core has none.
Person detection and photo capture need a Blink plan after the trial.
Alexa features are listed for Blink cameras in general, not for this model by name.
